title: Dualizability of the actual finite positive Koszul stages
statement: For every small ringed site (C,J,O), natural r, family b of r global sections, and natural m, the actual complex (ringedKoszulDiagram O r b).obj m of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system] is dualizable in the ordinary symmetric monoidal category of cochain complexes of O-module sheaves. No regularity or invertibility hypothesis on b is required.

source.place: sites-cohomology.tex, example-dual immediately before lemma-left-dual-complex and Tag 08JJ (lemma-dual-perfect-complex); the bounded-complex dual construction is also proved in WeilConjectures.Algebra.Homology.Monoidal.Dual.

proof.text: A single Koszul factor is a double complex with the unit in degrees zero and one and zero elsewhere. Its terms are dualizable, and it is strictly bounded between zero and one. Apply the proved CochainComplex.isDualizable_of_isStrictlyGE_of_isStrictlyLE theorem.

Induct on r using the actual recursive definition of ringedKoszulDiagram. The empty product is the tensor unit, which is dualizable; each successor is a tensor product of the first dualizable factor and the induction hypothesis. Apply IsDualizable.tensorObj.
